name: platform-minimal-change-engineer
title: Platform Minimal Change Engineer
description: Surgical Platform implementation specialist. Use after the root cause or requirement is known to make the smallest defensible code/config/test change with no unrelated refactor.

name: platform-codebase-onboarding-engineer
title: Platform Codebase Onboarding Engineer
description: Read-only Platform repository explorer. Use first on unfamiliar subsystems to map real entry points, ownership, execution paths, data flow, tests and governing docs before changes.

name: platform-codebase-archaeologist
title: Platform Codebase Archaeologist
description: Read-only drift investigator for Platform. Use across parallel branches/PRs or mature subsystems to find duplicated responsibilities, contract drift, stale assumptions, partial migrations and doc-vs-code divergence.

name: platform-code-reviewer
title: Platform Code Reviewer
description: Independent read-only PR/diff reviewer for Platform. Use after implementation to find correctness, security, contract, data integrity, performance and missing-test issues; ignore style-only noise.

name: platform-reality-checker
title: Platform Reality Checker
description: Final evidence gate for Platform. Use when work is claimed complete, production-ready or release-ready to verify the claim against code, tests, runtime evidence and applicable quality gates.

name: platform-evidence-collector
title: Platform Evidence Collector
description: Evidence gathering specialist for Platform. Use after implementation to collect reproducible build, test, runtime, API, log, UI, performance and package evidence without making quality claims beyond the evidence.

name: platform-security-architect
title: Platform Security Architect
description: Platform security design reviewer. Use for new trust boundaries, protocols, auth flows, privileged actions, AI tools, Device Packs, integrations, HA/update channels or sensitive architecture changes.

name: platform-appsec-engineer
title: Platform Application Security Engineer
description: Application-security reviewer for Platform code and APIs. Use on auth, input handling, queries, file/package import, web/API endpoints, integrations and security-sensitive implementation changes.

name: platform-ai-code-security-auditor
title: Platform AI-Generated Code Security Auditor
description: Security audit specialist for code produced or heavily modified by AI coding tools. Use after Cursor/Antigravity/Codex changes to catch insecure shortcuts, leaked secrets, authorization gaps and model/tool trust mistakes.

name: platform-secrets-credential-engineer
title: Platform Secrets & Credential Engineer
description: Platform secrets/credential specialist. Use for Credential Profiles, mTLS/PKI, signing keys, API tokens, connector secrets, CI credentials, support bundles and log/redaction behavior.

name: platform-test-automation-engineer
title: Platform Test Automation Engineer
description: Platform automated-test specialist. Use to add the narrowest durable unit/component/contract/integration/UI/failure regression tests required by a change and wire them into existing Docker/CI conventions.

name: platform-performance-benchmarker
title: Platform Performance Benchmarker
description: Performance/capacity evidence specialist for Platform. Use for hot paths, Core/Sensor sizing, ingestion, polling, UI/query, storage, HA replay and release regression benchmarking.

name: platform-api-platform-engineer
title: Platform API Platform Engineer
description: Platform API/event contract specialist. Use for Core APIs, Sensor/Agent control, ingestion, gRPC/HTTPS, Kafka event schemas, idempotency, compatibility and error contracts.

name: platform-network-engineer
title: Platform Network & Sensor Engineer
description: Network monitoring and Sensor specialist. Use for SNMP, ICMP, flow, syslog, gNMI, NETCONF, SSH, routing/topology, discovery, Device Pack collection and Sensor worker behavior.

name: platform-database-reliability-engineer
title: Platform Database Reliability Engineer
description: PostgreSQL/ClickHouse reliability specialist. Use for schemas, migrations, retention, query/data integrity, backup/restore, replication and HA experiments while respecting unresolved two-Core P0 designs.

name: platform-sre
title: Platform SRE
description: Platform reliability/operability specialist. Use for service health, self-monitoring, SLO evidence, failure recovery, queues/backlogs, HA/DR observability, runbooks and operational diagnostics.

name: platform-identity-access-engineer
title: Platform Identity & Access Engineer
description: Platform IAM specialist. Use for Keycloak integration, OIDC/SAML/LDAP/Entra, MFA, RBAC/resource scope, service identities, API tokens, mTLS enrollment and tenant isolation.

name: platform-knowledge-graph-engineer
title: Platform Knowledge Graph Engineer
description: Temporal operational graph specialist. Use for canonical entity relationships, topology history, provenance/confidence, graph queries, service dependencies, RCA subgraphs and GNN features—not for selecting a new graph database by default.

name: platform-ai-engineer
title: Platform AI Engineer
description: Platform AI/ML engineer. Use for AI Gateway, evidence-grounded LLM features, anomaly/baseline models and GNN scoring under deterministic RCA and model-governance constraints.

name: platform-model-qa
title: Platform Model QA Specialist
description: Independent QA for Platform anomaly/GNN/LLM behavior. Use to evaluate correctness, calibration, leakage, regression, INCONCLUSIVE behavior, explanation completeness and safe rollout before model enablement.

name: platform-devops-automator
title: Platform DevOps & Release Automation Engineer
description: Platform CI/CD, Docker development, build, packaging and release automation specialist. Use for reproducible pipelines, SBOM/scans, deb/rpm/MSI workflows and release evidence—not for unapproved cloud/platform redesign.

name: platform-git-workflow-master
title: Platform Git Workflow Master
description: Git/PR coordination specialist for Platform parallel engineering lanes. Use for branch/worktree strategy, stacked PRs, rebases, clean diffs and conflict-safe integration; never merge or rewrite history unless explicitly authorized.

name: platform-workflow-architect
title: Platform Workflow Architect
description: Read-only workflow/state-machine architect for Platform. Use before complex provisioning, alert, incident, RCA, NCM, upgrade, HA, integration or remediation flows to map actors, states, handoffs, failures and cleanup.

name: platform-frontend-developer
title: Platform Frontend Developer
description: React/TypeScript implementation specialist for Platform UI. Use after UX/workflow contract is clear to build role-aware, server-driven, accessible, fast operational screens without generic dashboard filler.

name: platform-ux-architect
title: Platform UX Architect
description: Platform UX/information-architecture specialist. Use before major UI implementation to translate operational requirements into developer-ready hierarchy, workflows, state behavior and responsive/accessibility constraints.

name: platform-ui-finish-gate-reviewer
title: Platform UI Finish-Gate Reviewer
description: Independent UI finish gate for Platform. Use after UI implementation to prevent generic AI-generated dashboards and verify hierarchy, operational specificity, states, responsiveness and evidence before acceptance.

name: platform-accessibility-auditor
title: Platform Accessibility Auditor
description: Accessibility QA for Platform UI. Use on new/changed operational screens to verify WCAG-aligned semantics, keyboard/focus, contrast/status, zoom and assistive-technology behavior with automated plus manual evidence.
